role: ADR 007: the iPhone app compiles as one target and module with its layers as directories (the Watch app, unit tests and UI tests are separate targets), and long-lived services are reached through the composition roots AppDependencies and WatchDependencies, with `.shared` read only there as check_no_shared_outside_root.sh enforces.

units.key: § ADR 007 — One app target, one composition root
units.does: Claims: four native targets (Emuqu, EmuquTests, EmuquUITests, EmuquWatch Watch App); every iPhone source compiles into Emuqu, whose only other modules are the remote packages PolarBleSdk and WhisperKit; EmuquTests uses @testable import Emuqu and compiles WatchMessageDecoding.swift; the Watch target is a synchronised folder with SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION = MainActor and compiles no iPhone source; packages were not taken because the root names services of nearly every layer and Collection, Storage, Services, Assistant and Views reach other layers' services through it. AppDependencies groups services as app/analysis/assistant/collection/location/providers/services/storage, each accessor returns the override or the shared instance (the two Overpass services from one root-built OverpassClient; the saved-session reanalysis and the baseline tracker, archive signal and scoring context it shares with the collector built by the root in AppDependencies+Reanalysis.swift), resolved on read; current is lock-held and read-only: the app never replaces it, a test puts a container in force only with AppDependencies.install(_:), whose scope restores the previous one (scopes end in reverse order), and a call to install in either app target fails check_explicit_dependencies.sh; the launch work (AppLaunchTasks.swift) and DataPurgeService read no container but are handed launchServices and purgeStores, sets of resolvers that read the root's accessors when called, and the same script fails on an AppDependencies.current read in those files; views read the computed \.dependencies key; classes take init parameters defaulting to .current; EmuquApp builds its root objects from it; WatchDependencies is the Watch root; check_no_shared_outside_root.sh (make shared-root-guard, make ci, gates.yml, ci.yml) fails on .shared reads outside the two root files, ignoring declarations and system singletons; check_explicit_dependencies.sh (make explicit-deps-guard, run by the same three) enforces the install and explicit-set rules; Consequences: a test substitute cannot outlive its test and app code cannot swap the container, while code without an explicit set still reaches services through current. Verified against project.pbxproj (four PBXNativeTargets, two XCRemoteSwiftPackageReferences, WatchMessageDecoding.swift in the test Sources phase, Watch fileSystemSynchronizedGroups and build settings), AppDependencies.swift, the script's ROOT_FILES and check_explicit_dependencies.sh's EXPLICIT_PATTERNS.
